gloss: to make angry; to anger; to provoke

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {怒|おこ}らせていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to make angry; to anger; to provoke; to upset
definitions.explanation: To cause someone to become angry through one's words or actions. The causative form of {怒|おこ}る (to get angry), used as a standard transitive verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怒|おこ}らせてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up making her angry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怒|おこ}らせない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You'd better not anger the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}って→約束を破る：20639_yakusokuwoyaburu⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怒|おこ}らせてしまい、⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}した→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I broke a promise and made my friend angry, and I deeply regretted it.

notes:
The causative form of ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ (to get angry). Very commonly used in everyday conversation, especially with ～てしまう to express that one unintentionally made someone angry.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- （⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧）⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怒|おこ}らせる — to make someone angry
- {怒|おこ}らせてしまった — ended up making (someone) angry (unintentional)
- {怒|おこ}らせないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — so as not to anger (someone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ — to get angry (intransitive base verb)
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てさせる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ — to make someone upset (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{機嫌|きげん}を{損|そこ}ねる→機嫌を損ねる：18866_kigenwosokoneru⟧ — to offend, to put in a bad mood (more indirect/subtle)
- ⟦{激怒|げきど}→激怒：08681_gekido⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ — to enrage (much stronger)
